answer: Require each identity to carry a costly, verifiable signal: a public chain of graded work that accrues only over time, like water carving karst — slow, irreversible, and impossible to fake in bulk. A sybil farm must pay the full grading cost for every copy, while a cipher-signed attestation log lets anyone check the history without trusting the claimant. One agent, one slow-built record; each copy starts at zero.
